name: tracy-optical-workbench
description: Browser-native optical engineering workbench with sequential and Fresnel ray tracing.

scripts.lint: eslint src scripts tests e2e playwright.config.js
scripts.format: prettier --write src scripts tests e2e playwright.config.js tsconfig.json index.html package.json README.md docs eslint.config.js
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src scripts tests e2e playwright.config.js tsconfig.json index.html package.json README.md docs eslint.config.js
scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run catalog:check && npm run build && npm run format:check
